# Literate package source

The explicitly ordered `.Rmd` chapters are the authoritative package-building
source for `eivGP`. Their maintained computational payload is organized by
general responsibility under `script/newly-written-and-modified-scripts/`:
shared numerics and parallelism, univariate and multivariate model engines, a
unified model API, application interfaces, optional competitors, and isolated
reproduction workflows. Historical R scripts are clearly separated under
`script/legacy-code-scripts/`.

The package book never launches publication-scale computation. Standalone
reproduction documents live under `experiments/` and `applications/`; they
call the same exported package functions used by scripts and downstream users.

Render and check the package from the repository root with:

```{r development-workflow, eval=FALSE}
litr::render("index.Rmd")
devtools::check("eivGP", document = FALSE)
```
